ambient_events: The bar on the outside of the door is oiled and moves silently. That's somehow worse.
Somebody has left a full mug on the floor by the cot, gone cold.
The tally scratched into the plaster stops at nineteen and isn't continued.
description: A bare cell with a chair, a cot, a jug, and a door that bars from the outside. When somebody comes back from a run and can't account for the missing hours, this is where they wait while the Watch work out whether the machine got to them. Nobody pretends it's anything else. There's a shelf of paperbacks, softened by handling, and a scratched tally on the wall that stops at nineteen.
name: The Quiet Room
